route_title: Bounded Defect Layer Optimization with Mirror Regularization
compilation_rationale: Compiled 21-layer HfO2/SiO2 defect cavity on fused silica. Defect layer constrained to 480–550 nm. All coating layers optimizable near quarter-wave optical thickness at 1550 nm. Dual-band objectives drive passband transmission and stopband reflection. L2 thickness regularization noted as design preference.
